items.title: Introducing the Apache Spark optimization agent for Amazon EMR Serverless and AWS Glue ETL
items.summary: The Apache Spark optimization agent for Amazon EMR Serverless and AWS Glue ETL is now generally available. It analyzes completed Spark job runs and returns cost or performance optimization recommendations in minutes, each grounded in the job's own Spark telemetry, so any engineer can tune jobs without deep Spark expertise.
items.creator: Neil Mukerje
